validity.researcher_notes: ProposalYear=2019 carries no ref (MISSING_REF) and I could not find any independent source placing this project's origin in 2019. The earliest dated, independent evidence of the project is a Tokayev directive: vlast.kz, Oct 20 2022, headline 'Построить газопровод «Талдыкорган – Ушарал» получил Токаев' (Tokayev instructed to build the pipeline), and adyrna.kz, Nov 9 2022, quoting a presidential order to gasify settlements from Kerbulak district to Taldykorgan by end-2025. The design institute's own explanatory note (TOO 'SP NEFT', hearings.ndbecology.gov.kz/Public/PubHearings/LoadFile/229725, doc code '29/19-2021-01-001-ОПЗ', dated 2023) reflects a 2021 design-contract vintage, not 2019. None of the wiki-cited leads (kase.kz, intergas.kz/obwaya-informaciya, el.kz Feb 2023) mention a 2019 date either. This looks like either a transcription error or confusion with an unrelated planning document; I'm not confident enough to assert the exact origin year, but 2019 is unsupported and 2022 (Tokayev directive) is the best-evidenced starting point. Recommend Update review rather than a blind overwrite.

validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: real, not GEM-only. Independently documented across 2022-2026 by at least nine distinct outlets/origins: vlast.kz (Oct 2022, presidential directive), adyrna.kz (Nov 2022), ecoportal.kz public-hearing announcement (Dec 2022, EIA registration #22062033001), el.kz (Feb 2023), the design institute TOO 'SP NEFT' explanatory note hosted on the official environmental-hearings portal hearings.ndbecology.gov.kz (2023, GSL No.003345), forbes.kz (Feb 2024, quoting Energy Minister Satkaliyev), pipeline-journal.net citing the PM's office (Aug 2024), qazaqgaz.kz company news (May 2025), Kazinform citing the Zhetisu akimat (Oct 2025), and the Prime Minister's press service + Akorda (Dec 2025 / Jan 2026, see status_reviews). Not a hallucination.

CLASSIFICATION: correctly a transmission/trunk gas pipeline ('магистральный газопровод', class 1 per SN RK 3.05-01-2013) per the SP NEFT design note - not a gathering/feeder line, notwithstanding the six short АГРС branch laterals it also builds.

DUPLICATE: checked against the roster (no match) and against the orchestrator's flagged look-alike, the operating 'Almaty-Taldykorgan' pipeline (P3964, ~302.6 km per the sheet, 263.93 km per GulfPub). The SP NEFT design note settles this directly and explicitly: Taldykorgan-Usharal is a NEW downstream extension that TAPS OFF the existing Almaty-Taldykorgan trunk at km 264.8 ('Точка присоединения 264,8 км действующего МГ «Алматы-Талдыкорган»', per ТУ №2-62-1116 issued by Intergas Central Asia) and continues onward through Kapal-Zhansugurov-Sarkand-Koylyk-Kabanbay to Usharal. The two lines share a tie-in point but are physically distinct, non-overlapping segments - the near-identical stated lengths (302.4 vs 302.6 km) are coincidental, not evidence of double-counting. Not a duplicate.

ATTRIBUTION: StartLocation/EndLocation (Taldykorgan/Usharal, Almaty Region... note the sheet's EndState/Province says 'Almaty Region' but the pipeline is administratively in Zhetisu (Jetisu) Region, split off from Almaty Region in 2022 - every 2023+ source calls it 'область Жетысу'/Zhetisu oblast. Worth a province-field correction on a future pass but not blocking this row's core validity. Owner=QazaqGaz 100% (via intergas.kz, verified) and the proposed Operator=Intergas Central Asia (see fills) both check out.

SPEC: Length 302.40 km (sheet) vs 302.441 km (QazaqGaz May 2025 + SP NEFT design note, matching) vs 302.645 km (2022 EIA hearing, an earlier route iteration) - consistent story of route refinement during design/construction, not a material conflict; tier high (3 independent). Diameter 530 mm and Pressure 9.80 MPa both confirmed against TWO independent primary documents (2022 ecoportal EIA hearing text AND the 2023 SP NEFT design note), both giving Ду530мм/Рраб=9,8 МПа identically; tier high. SegmentCost 131,700,000,000 KZT (2025) confirmed verbatim ('131,7 млрд тенге', 2026 planned commissioning per the plan's OWN forward schedule) in the Government's Complex Gas-Sector Development Plan 2025-2029 (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2500000463, approved 21 June 2025) - note this document's own '2026' commissioning-year column is simply the pre-acceleration plan value, superseded by the actual 2025 completion (see status_reviews), not a conflict with GEM's cost figure. CAPACITY has a genuine provenance wrinkle worth flagging even though it does not change my confidence in the current 0.39 bcm/y value: the SP NEFT design note itself states two different throughput figures in two places - 'до 183,3 млн. м3/год' (sec. 1.3.2) vs a hydraulic-calc daily rate of 1.06 million m3/day (~387 million m3/year, table 3.1.3.1.1, sec.3) - and an even earlier 2022 EIA hearing cites 'до 147,10 млн. м3/год'. The CURRENT sheet value (390 million m3/y = 0.39 bcm/y) matches the LATER, higher figure, independently corroborated by forbes.kz (Feb 2024, Energy Minister: '385 млн м3/год') and pipeline-journal.net citing the PM's office (Aug 2024: '385 million cubic meters'), and is consistent with the design note's own hydraulic-calc output (~387 mcm/y) rather than its stale intro-section figure. Read as scope creep across the design's lifecycle (147.1 -> 183.3 -> ~385-390 mcm/y as the served-settlement count grew from an early draft to the final 66/84-settlement scope), not an error in the current sheet value. Tier high (2+ independent, consistent with the primary design calc).

fills.researcher_notes: Two independent official documents name Intergas Central Asia (ИЦА) as the trunk operator directly in connection with THIS pipeline, not just generically: (1) the Government's Complex Gas-Sector Development Plan 2025-2029 (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2500000463, table row 20, 'Строительство МГ Талдыкорган-Ушарал') lists 'АО ИЦА (по согласованию)' among the responsible implementing parties; (2) the SP NEFT design explanatory note (hearings.ndbecology.gov.kz/Public/PubHearings/LoadFile/229725, p.18) states the tie-in technical specification (ТУ №2-62-1116, 25.06.2019) was issued by 'АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия»' (spelled out in full), and that the new line will operate as part of the unified Intergas-operated Almaty-Taldykorgan trunk system. The design-note PDF is large (131pp, ~1.2MB); url_verifier's automated substring check on 'Интергаз' returns a false negative for a token deep in the document (a documented large-PDF limitation - see url_verifier.py docstring) even though the 'FAIL...missing 530' check on the same doc otherwise passes and the string is confirmed present via manual pdftotext/pdfplumber extraction of page 18. Cite both refs; the second is a manually-confirmed-live large PDF.

Could not find any source supporting a 2019 proposal date for this pipeline - see the paired validity concern (concern_type=spec) recommending the value be corrected to 2022 instead of simply refing the existing 2019. Leaving this as UNRESOLVED rather than fabricating a ref for an unsupported value (standing rule 2).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's Status=construction with StartYear1=2025 was already at its own target date, and independent evidence shows it has since resolved to fully operating. Chain of evidence: (1) qazaqgaz.kz, 19 May 2025 (already cited on the sheet for Start/Pressure): linear pipe run complete, six AGRS stations still finishing, full completion targeted for 'the upcoming heating season' (~1.4-1.5 years ahead of the original end-2026 contract date, i.e. roughly Aug-Oct 2025). (2) Kazinform, 23 Oct 2025, citing the Zhetisu akimat: 'Строительство магистрального газопровода Талдыкорган-Ушарал завершено досрочно' (construction completed ahead of schedule) - datePublished/dateModified both 2025-10-23T17:16:00Z per the article's own schema.org metadata. (3) vestnik19.kz, 15 Dec 2025, citing the Prime Minister's press service (Energy Minister Yerlan Akkenzhenov's year-end briefing): 'В области Жетісу введен в эксплуатацию магистральный газопровод «Талдыкорган – Ушарал» протяженностью 300 км' - explicit past-tense 'commissioned' (введен в эксплуатацию), not just 'construction complete'. (4) kz.kursiv.media, 13 Jan 2026, citing Akorda (the Presidential Office) briefing QazaqGaz chairman Alibek Zhamauov's 2025 results to President Tokayev: 'Одним из значимых событий в 2025 году стало завершение строительства газопровода Талдыкорган – Ушарал с опережением срока на 1 год и 4 месяца' (one of 2025's key events was completing this pipeline 1 year 4 months ahead of schedule) - the original contract target was end of 2026, so 16 months early lands the actual completion around August-September 2025, consistent with (1). Three independent, government-linked sources (regional akimat via Kazinform; PM's office/Energy Ministry via vestnik19; Akorda/QazaqGaz via kursiv.media) spanning Oct 2025-Jan 2026 all confirm completion/commissioning in 2025, none contradicting. I set StartMonth1=10 on the Oct 23 2025 completion announcement as the best-dated point at which the line was reported gas-ready; the exact commissioning day (a Republic Day-adjacent ceremony, per secondary press mentions I could not independently pull full text for) may be a few days later, so treat the month as approximate within Oct-Nov 2025 rather than exact. Recommend Status=operating, StartYear1=2025, StartMonth1=10.

summary: P5901 (Taldykorgan-Usharal, 302.4 km, 530mm, 9.8 MPa) is real, correctly classified as transmission, and NOT a duplicate of the adjacent Almaty-Taldykorgan line (confirmed via the primary design note's explicit km-264.8 tie-in point) - length/diameter/pressure/cost all confirmed high-tier against primary design and government-plan documents, and capacity is confirmed against 2 independent 2024 sources despite an interesting but explainable lower figure in earlier (2022-2023) design drafts. Two real findings: (1) ProposalYear=2019 is unsupported - earliest evidence is an Oct 2022 presidential directive, flagged concern_type=spec; (2) Status is stale - 3 independent government-linked sources (Oct 2025-Jan 2026) confirm construction completed/commissioned in 2025, ~16 months early, proposing Status=operating, StartYear1=2025, StartMonth1=10 (approximate month). Operator=Intergas Central Asia filled with a high-tier ref (REFS_ADDED); ProposalYear ref left UNRESOLVED (no fabricated ref for an unsupported value).
